criteria.title: Recognizable Main Subject
criteria.description: The primary visual figure/form is clearly legible and identifiable, not an ambiguous abstract tangle.

criteria.title: Communicated Central Metaphor
criteria.description: The central visual metaphor (e.g. roots becoming a guitar, descending tear turning into water ripples) is visually depicted.

criteria.title: Song Emotional Alignment
criteria.description: Color temperature, contrast, and posture evoke the emotional narrative of the track.

criteria.title: Deliberate & Expressive Linework
criteria.description: Continuous contour line demonstrates organic weight variation, fluid curves, and intentional pathing.

criteria.title: Distinctive Composition & Space
criteria.description: Intentional negative space (>50%) and asymmetrical staging ensure the poster is distinct from other songs.

feedback: Subject description is overly abstract; anchor with concrete physical nouns.
